messages.subject: An extra round reactive function ?
parts:
This is a modification of the thread by Mark Edmondson (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/shiny$20module|sort:relevance/shiny-discuss/o5B_BncwqDs/l_yC3L9nAQAJ). Joe gave a clear explanation on the need to return the reactive. That worked pretty well as Mark intended. The post was marked as answered. So I thought to start a new one as my objective is a little different.

Basically instead of returning a renderTable I would like simply a data.frame. But I was surprised to find out that my modified code did not work.

Here is the console output:

[1] "X 1 mpg "
[1] "X 2 cyl "

# the output after select 21 under mpg
[1] "X 1 mpg 21"
 [1] "Y 21"   "Y 21"   "Y 22.8" "Y 21.4" "Y 18.7" "Y 18.1" "Y 14.3" "Y 24.4" "Y 22.8" "Y 19.2" "Y 17.8" "Y 16.4"
[13] "Y 17.3" "Y 15.2" "Y 10.4" "Y 10.4" "Y 14.7" "Y 32.4" "Y 30.4" "Y 33.9" "Y 21.5" "Y 15.5" "Y 15.2" "Y 13.3"
[25] "Y 19.2" "Y 27.3" "Y 26"   "Y 30.4" "Y 15.8" "Y 19.7" "Y 15"   "Y 21.4"
[1] "X 2 cyl "
[1] "X 1 mpg "  # why this and the next line
[1] "X 2 cyl "

# the output after select 4 under cyl
[1] "X 1 mpg "
[1] "X 2 cyl 4"
 [1] "Y 6" "Y 6" "Y 4" "Y 6" "Y 8" "Y 6" "Y 8" "Y 4" "Y 4" "Y 6" "Y 6" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 4"
[19] "Y 4" "Y 4" "Y 4" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 8" "Y 4" "Y 4" "Y 4" "Y 8" "Y 6" "Y 8" "Y 4"

Can anyone please help explain, and suggest a solution?


Thanks!

dynamicSelectInput <- function(id, label, multiple = FALSE){
  ns <- shiny::NS(id)
  shiny::selectInput(ns("dynamic_select"), label,
                     choices = NULL, multiple = multiple, width = "100%")
}


dynamicSelect <- function(input, output, session, the_data, column, default_select = NULL){
  
  observe({
    shiny::validate(
      shiny::need(the_data(),"Fetching data")
    )
    dt <- the_data()
    
    testthat::expect_is(dt, "data.frame")
    testthat::expect_is(column, "character")
    
    choice <- unique(dt[[column]])
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "dynamic_select",
                      choices = choice,
                      selected = default_select)
    
  })
  
  return(reactive(input$dynamic_select))
  
}


outerTableUI <- function(id, aggs){
  
  ns <- shiny::NS(id)
  
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      lapply(seq_along(aggs), function(x) {
        column(width = 4,
               dynamicSelectInput(ns(aggs[[x]]), aggs[[x]], multiple = TRUE)
        )
      })
    )#,
    # fluidRow(
    #   ## if this works should be able to filter this table
    #   ## by the selected filters above
    #
    #   # tableOutput(ns("table"))
    #
    # )
    
  )
}

#'  server side

outerTable <- function(input, output, session, the_data, aggs){
  
  selectResults <- lapply(setNames(aggs, aggs), function(agg) {
    callModule(module = dynamicSelect,
               id = agg,
               the_data = the_data,
               column = agg)
  })
  
  # x <- reactiveValuesToList(input)
  # str(x)
  
  # new_data <- reactive({
    old_data <- the_data()
    new_data <- NULL
    for(i in seq_along(aggs)){
      agg <- aggs[i]
      print(paste('X',i,agg,selectResults[[agg]]()))
      if(is.null(inputA <- selectResults[[agg]]())){
        next
      } else{
        old_col <- old_data[[agg]]
        print(paste('Y',old_col))
        new_data <- old_data[old_col %in% inputA,]
        old_data <- new_data
      }
      
    }
    
    new_data
    
  # })
  
  
  # new_data()
  
  # output$table <- renderTable({
  #   # browser()
  #   new_data()
  # })
  
}


### Call via:
library(shiny)
library(DT)
the_data <- mtcars
the_filters = names(mtcars)[1:2]

shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    outerTableUI("debug_dynamic",
                 aggs = the_filters),
    DT::dataTableOutput("tableX")
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session){
    
    o<- reactive ({
      callModule(outerTable,
                 "debug_dynamic",
                 the_data = reactive(the_data),
                 aggs = the_filters
      )
    })
    output$tableX <- DT::renderDataTable({  o() })
  }
)
